question: In Box: Add the tag design-review to the PDF in the Product Specs folder whose description mentions the mobile redesign, is under 2 MB, and has exactly 3 comments on it, not counting replies. If there isn't one, just tell me.
final:
There isn't one. I checked the Product Specs folder (it contains just 3 items), and the only PDF in it is:

- **Payment Redesign Spec.pdf** — description says "Design spec for the payment *payment* redesign flow" (payment, not mobile), it's 3 MB (over the 2 MB limit), and it has 0 comments — so it fails all three criteria.

The other two files (Brand Guidelines.docx, Mobile Redesign Specs.xlsx) aren't PDFs. No tag added.
